next_sound_fix.name: Bounded constant-argument specialization for known static call targets.
next_sound_fix.hook: Before pruning summaries/inlining: collect actual CallStatic argument origins; clone a known HIR body with certified symbolic constant argument facts, fold constant comparisons and unreachable CFG, then apply existing bounded inlining. Prefer profitable reduced clones; keep original generic entry for remaining calls/closures/FFI.
first_scope: Tracing fixed image; actual available callee body and compatible ABI.

Literal scalar arguments first; simple enum constants only with resolved declaration identity, canonical identity-equality proof and actual getter-return/value proof. Never infer enum identity from a function name or static type.

Keep original argument evaluation order, getter calls and pending exception paths unless a separate initialization/effects certificate proves elimination legal. A successful getter body or guarded exact returned value is needed; declarations alone do not prove runtime value.

Known enum arguments can fold from/to pattern dispatch in a reduced clone; retain generic fallback where proof is absent, including changed SDK equality, enhanced enums, mixins, ambiguous ancestry and escaping identity observations.
Per-target clone count, total code-growth budget and post-fold size/inlining budget prevent combinatorial binaries. No function-name-specific optimization.
semantic_checks: Two distinct simple enum values, equal values, different enum classes, nullable/unknown inputs and ordinary scalar literal specialization.
Side effects and exceptions while evaluating arguments; zero-iteration loops; cold/warm enum initialization and failed initialization/retry.
Changed SDK Object/Enum equality and native alias; custom callbacks/FFI/closures retain generic target.
NaN, infinities, signed zero, Mint overflow and clamp/toInt error paths remain exact.
ActualCLI OFF/ON 2736color cases plus dynamic230case fixture and GCstress, fullgate, final matched caller assembly, binary size and quiet paired timings.
next_sound_fix.insertion_candidate: lib.rs before prune_program_hir, via a bounded specialization pass adjacent to optimize::prepare_for_pruning (currently line482). It must promote local arguments/dataflow before collecting facts and prune each new clone before summaries; optimize::optimize builds its inlining copy inventory only later (after mem2reg, currently line178). Literal-only scope needs no SDK body transport; symbolic enum scope requires lowering-certified identity/value premises and actual normal-return/getter proof.

limitations: Raw decompiler C warns about bad instruction data at external cold target boundaries; quantitative counts use complete mapped assembly coverage.
Upstream private snapshot table offsets do not prove semantic callee names without table mapping.
F64 listread reboxing exists as a conditional path; runtime active storage shape and allocation counts were not measured, so it is not asserted as the dominant execution bottleneck.

Global inlining-threshold increase is not justified: current HIR genericbody is far above BODY_LIMIT40 and contains cache-state getter operations. Specialize and prune before deciding whether to inline.
